payload.outcome: Fixed 2026-09-19 in PR #2920. docs/clinical-hazard-controls.json now carries reviewedPathDigests (sha256 per cited path) and the checker falls back to them when the reviewed commit is unreachable, which is what a squash merge always makes it. The pass condition matches the old one: the commit check asked only whether a cited path EXISTED, so a missing record still fails and a CHANGED file warns rather than failing -- gating on unchanged content would turn every later PR touching a cited control red until someone re-sealed, which buys reflexive re-sealing. Sealed with npm run governance:seal-hazard-controls, idempotent and Prettier-stable. 12 passed.
